nodes.diagnosis: mean reward 0.4068 over episodes 1, 2, 3, 4; main new mistake: berthed a ship inside a no-movement window (fog or bar closure) (3 evidence events). One change: add its rule.
nodes.change: Before choosing a berth hour, read the no_moves windows in the rules; never berth inside a no-movement window, berth at its end.

mistakes.what: berthed a ship inside a no-movement window (fog or bar closure)
mistakes.rule: Before choosing a berth hour, read the no_moves windows in the rules; never berth inside a no-movement window, berth at its end.

mistakes.what: put more cranes to work in hoot hours than the smaller hoot pool allows
mistakes.rule: Keep the cranes working in every hour within that hour's pool; the hoot pool (03:00-08:00) is smaller, so give fewer cranes in hoot hours or berth after the hoot shift.

mistakes.what: put more cranes to work in some hours than the crane pool has
mistakes.rule: Add up the cranes of every ship alongside in each hour and keep the total within the pool, less any crane outage; cut cranes on the ship with the most slack first.

mistakes.what: berthed or released more ships in one hour than the movement limit allows
mistakes.rule: Respect the movement limit (berthings plus departures per hour): when ships arrive together, stagger their berth hours by one hour.

mistakes.what: placed two ships, or a ship and a closed block, on the same section-hour
mistakes.rule: Never overlap another ship, a ship already alongside or a closed block on any section-hour: pick other sections or a later berth hour.

mistakes.what: moved scheduled ships off their planned section (5 per ship moved)
mistakes.rule: Keep every scheduled ship on its planned section (each ship moved off it costs 5): start from baseline_plan, move ships back to their planned section one at a time, screen each with ship_timeline, then check.

mistakes.what: left ships departing after their due hour
mistakes.rule: For each late ship (departure past due), try more cranes up to its maximum or an earlier berth hour, screen with ship_timeline, then check; lateness costs sections x hours.

mistakes.what: planned without the live feed's ETA updates
mistakes.rule: Call live_ships at hour 0 and read the eta_update events: never plan a berth before a ship's updated ETA.
